docs.message:
chore(deps): update @lernapps/site to the bilingual frame

## Intent

The English docs index can only pass its check with the bilingual frame, which is now merged in lernapps.github.io.

## Key changes

- docs pins @lernapps/site to the merged bilingual frame, on the branch of the English docs index, so both land together.

## Dependencies and side effects

- apps takes the same pin through the Renovate update merged into its English branch.
